review.posthog_relevance: Adds runtime-aware model and adapter selection, catalogue-driven effort lookup, and permission mode coercion for AI agent execution, supporting a broader multi-runtime strategy.
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate a substantive, bounded capability improvement rather than narrow maintenance. P1.F20.H2 replaces a static, model-specific effort lookup with a runtime-aware, catalogue-driven lookup, establishing a shared configuration mechanism. P1.F22.H3 replaces a single-mode picker with runtime-specific mode lists and fallback coercion, supporting permission mode,

observations.behavior: Replaces a static, model-specific effort lookup with a runtime-aware, catalogue-driven lookup; adds runtime adapter and permission mode helpers.
observations.code_quote: const efforts = catalogue.find((option) => option.model === model)?.supported_efforts ?? FALLBACK_EFFORTS
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Composer to support multiple runtime adapters and their respective effort and permission vocabularies, rather than a single Claude-only backend. This could support future Codex or other runtime implementations without changing the shared backend, provided the backend also supports the new catalogue and runtime fields.

observations.behavior: Replaces a single-mode picker with runtime-specific mode lists and a fallback coercion, while retaining the original mode option and label lookup.
observations.posthog_connection: This change could support PostHog's AI agent permission handling, allowing the frontend to distinguish between Claude and Codex runtimes and coerce incompatible permission modes into a safe equivalent before execution.
